item.creativeengineering.carbon_packed_i: Iron packed in carbon, ready to be _baked into blister steel_.
In a Bulk Blasting fan stream
Turns into _Blister Steel_. A vanilla Blast Furnace works too, one at a time.
block.creativeengineering.coke_oven_bric: Placed together, bricks form a _Coke Oven_ up to 3x3x3 that cooks coal into _coke_ and _creosote_.
Cokes coal. Fire or magma is half speed, a lit Blaze Burner full speed, superheated double.
Adds four coking slots: bigger ovens coke more at once.
Feed coal in, take coke and creosote out from any side.
block.creativeengineering.blast_furnace_: Placed together, bricks form a _Blast Furnace_ that turns iron and coke into _steel_ or _cast iron_.
Smelts. A bigger furnace holds more and works faster.
block.creativeengineering.alloy_furnace_: Placed together, bricks form an _Alloy Furnace_ for mixing metals.
item.creativeengineering.rod_die.tooltip: The press shapes _rods_ instead of plates. Dies never wear out.
Fit the die. Empty hand to take it back.
item.creativeengineering.gear_die.toolti: The press shapes _gears_ instead of plates. Dies never wear out.
Fit the die. Empty hand to take it back.
block.creativeengineering.treated_planks: Wood soaked in _creosote_: weather-proof timber for industrial builds.
block.creativeengineering.treated_beam.t: A heavy _treated timber beam_ that joins up with its neighbours.
block.creativeengineering.diesel_crankca: The heart of a _Diesel Engine_. Crankcases in a line facing the same way form one engine.
Runs at _64 RPM_ once started. More cylinders and better fuel give more stress capacity.
A tank or pipe at its side
Pulls fuel straight in, no pump needed.
Starts it: a Hand Crank works. The front never joins the output.
block.creativeengineering.diesel_cylinde: A _cylinder_ for a Diesel Engine. Up to two per crankcase, leaning out above it.
Adds stress capacity, puffs exhaust and thumps in time.
block.creativeengineering.diesel_flywhee: A heavy _flywheel_ for the engine's output shaft.
With a Drive Chain to a sprocket
Steps speed up _4x_ (or down, from the sprocket side).
block.creativeengineering.drive_pulley.t: A small _Drive Sprocket_ on a shaft, for _Drive Chains_.
Turns _4x faster_ than the flywheel; sprocket to sprocket is 1:1.
item.creativeengineering.drive_belt.tool: A _Drive Chain_ links a flywheel and a sprocket, or two sprockets, on parallel shafts.
Carries rotation and stress like a Create chain drive.
Fit the chain: first one wheel, then the other.
block.creativeengineering.andesite_campf: A stand that _holds a campfire_ under machines.
Gives _passive heat_ to Fermenting Vats, Distilling Tanks and Create boilers.
Lit: the air stream _smokes_ items. Soul fire _haunts_ them.
Fit it. Flint and steel lights it, a shovel puts it out.
block.creativeengineering.fermenting_vat: A lidded vat that _ferments_ fruit, grain and honey into drinks.
Forms one vat up to 3x3x4, like a Create tank.
Ferments. A campfire works; a lit Blaze Burner is twice as fast, superheated three times.
Water and ingredients in, the drink out, from any side.
block.creativeengineering.distilling_tan: A column that _splits liquids by boiling point_: spirits from brews, fuels from crude oil.
The bottom is the _boiler_; each level above collects one fraction.
Settle lower. Each level holds 1 B per block until drained.
Taps or pipes on a level
Draw that level off into storage.
block.creativeengineering.tap.tooltip.su: A _valve-tap_ for a Distilling Tank level.
block.creativeengineering.tap.tooltip.be: Pours that level down any Steel Pipe run into tanks _at its height or lower_, no pump.
block.creativeengineering.steel_tank.too: A _steel storage tank_ that joins with its neighbours like a Create tank.
block.creativeengineering.steel_pipe.too: Heavy _steel pipe_. Works like a Create pipe, without windows.
From a Tap or a Wellhead
Carries their flow without a pump.
item.creativeengineering.seismic_probe.t: A thumper that listens for _oil veins_ under the ground.
Reports a vein in this chunk and its rate, or the nearest one's rough distance and direction.
block.creativeengineering.pumpjack.toolt: The _Crank Gearbox_ of a Pumpjack: turns a shaft's rotation into a pumping stroke.
Build in a row ahead of it
A column of _2-6 girders or industrial iron_ 1-3 blocks on, a _Walking Beam Bearing_ on top, a _Wellhead_ 1-6 past it.
Strokes deeper: more out, more stress. It needs a taller column so the horsehead clears the well.
Place the bearing or Wellhead in the next spot.
block.creativeengineering.walking_beam_b: The pillow-block bearing that carries a Pumpjack's _walking beam_.
On top of a girder column
The beam, horsehead and linkage appear, sized to the rig.
block.creativeengineering.wellhead.toolt: A _well_ casing head. It brings up whatever lies below while a _Pumpjack_ strokes it.
Draws _crude oil_ (use a Seismic Probe to find one).
Water in the Overworld, lava in the Nether.
Push into pipes on any side, no pump needed.
item.creativeengineering.oil_can.tooltip: A pump oiler of _lubricant_ for Create machines.
Lubricates it for a day: its stress on the network drops by a _quarter_.
block.creativeengineering.brass_campfire: A stand that _holds a campfire_ under machines.
Gives _passive heat_ to Fermenting Vats, Distilling Tanks and Create boilers.
Lit: the air stream _smokes_ items. Soul fire _haunts_ them.

creativeengineering.ponder.cementation.t: A Mechanical Press over a Basin packs iron into carbon
One iron ingot and two coal or charcoal make Carbon-Packed Iron
Coke is four times better: two iron and one coke make two
A fan blowing through lava bakes everything in its air stream: Bulk Blasting
Carbon-Packed Iron comes out as Blister Steel
A lit Blaze Burner works in place of lava. A vanilla Blast Furnace can do it too, one at a time
creativeengineering.ponder.coke_oven.hea: Coking Coal in a Coke Oven
creativeengineering.ponder.coke_oven.tex: Coke Oven Bricks placed together form one oven, up to 3 wide and 3 tall
Every brick adds four coking slots: bigger ovens coke more at once
It needs heat below every column. Fire or magma works at half speed, a Blaze Burner at full speed, superheated at double
Funnels, hoppers, belts and arms feed it from any side
Coal comes out as Coal Coke, logs as Charcoal. Pulling from it only ever takes finished items. By hand, right-click with an empty hand
While it cokes, smoke rises from the top and it crackles. Embers along the bottom just mean it has heat
Coking also gives Creosote Oil. Pump it, or use a bucket, on any brick. When the tank is full the rest vents in a dark burst, and the oven keeps going
creativeengineering.ponder.blast_furnace: Cast Iron and Steel in a Blast Furnace
Blast Furnace Bricks stack into one furnace, up to 3 wide and 6 tall. It needs a heated Blaze Burner below
Feed iron and fuel from any side. Coke smelts 2 iron, charcoal 1, coal half
On its own it makes Cast Iron
Encased Fans blowing into the bottom layer give it an air blast: now it makes Steel. Each extra fan makes it a quarter faster
Take out metal and slag from any side. Slag is a bonus: when it's full it's thrown away, never blocking the furnace
creativeengineering.ponder.alloy_furnace: Bulk Alloys in an Alloy Furnace
Alloy Furnace Bricks form a furnace from any solid box, 2 to 4 blocks on each side
Every column needs a heated Blaze Burner below. Superheat them all for the toughest alloys
Feed ingredients from any side. Half the bricks' count of batches run at once. The burners are its only running cost
Fans blowing into the bottom layer are optional: each one makes it a quarter faster
Take the alloys out from any side. Create's heated alloys and Ender IO's alloys work here too
When alloys share ingredients, wrench a brick to an output hatch and set its filter: only matching alloys are made
creativeengineering.ponder.press_dies.te: Right-click a Mechanical Press with a die to fit it. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand takes it out
With a die fitted, the press only shapes what that die makes: rods or gears. It works on belts and depots as usual
Dies never wear out. Without a die the press is an ordinary press again
creativeengineering.ponder.diesel_engine: Building and Starting a Diesel Engine
Crankcases in a line, all facing the same way, make one engine. The back end is where power comes out
Cylinders sit diagonally above, leaning out: up to two per crankcase. Each one adds stress capacity
A tank against a crankcase side feeds it directly, no pump. Creosote works; plant oil, ethanol and better fuels give more
To start it, turn whatever is at the front: a Hand Crank works. The front never connects to the output
Once it fires it runs on its own at 64 RPM. Take power off the flywheel shaft; it stops when the fuel runs out
creativeengineering.ponder.campfire_stan: Campfire Stands: Heat and Fan Catalysts
A Campfire Stand holds a campfire under your machines. Right-click it with a campfire to fit one
Lit, it gives passive heat to a Fermenting Vat, a Distilling Tank or a Create boiler above it
Air blows straight through a stand. Through a lit campfire, a fan's stream smokes the items it reaches
With a soul campfire the same stream haunts them instead
creativeengineering.ponder.fermenting_va: Fermenting Vats placed together form one vat, up to 3 wide and 4 tall, like a Create tank
It needs heat underneath. A lit Campfire Stand is enough; a lit Blaze Burner is twice as fast, superheated three times
Add water and the ingredients by pipe, funnel or hand: apples make cider, berries wine, honey mead, wheat ale, potatoes hooch
Pipe the finished drink out of any side, or bucket it. Bottle it with a Spout to drink it
creativeengineering.ponder.distilling.he: Distilling with a Column and Taps
creativeengineering.ponder.distilling.te: Distilling Tanks stacked on heat form a column, 1 to 3 wide and up to 8 tall
The bottom is the boiler: pipe the brew in there. Each level above collects one fraction, the heaviest lowest
A Tap on a level drains it. Right-click to open or close it; redstone holds it shut
It pours down Steel Pipe into any tank at its own height or lower: gravity does the work, no pump needed
One Tap per level splits the run: hooch gives vodka and ethanol; crude oil, on a Blaze Burner, gives four fuels
creativeengineering.ponder.drive_chain.t: A Drive Chain links a Flywheel and a Drive Sprocket on parallel shafts, 2 to 8 blocks apart
Right-click one wheel with the chain, then the other. Flywheel to sprocket steps speed up four times
It is a real kinetic link: stress passes along it. A sprocket can take a second chain to relay power on
creativeengineering.ponder.pumpjack.head: Prospecting and Pumping Oil
creativeengineering.ponder.pumpjack.text: Use a Seismic Probe on the ground: it hears an oil vein in this chunk, or tells you roughly where the nearest one is
On a vein chunk, start with a Crank Gearbox. It faces away from you and takes a shaft on either side
Build a column of 2 to 6 girders or industrial iron 1 to 3 blocks ahead, and put a Walking Beam Bearing on top
A Wellhead goes 1 to 6 blocks past the column. A longer reach strokes deeper, for more oil and more stress
A long reach swings the horsehead low: it needs a taller column to clear the well
Turn the gearbox and the beam nods. Full stroke at 64 RPM; nothing is formed, every part is its own block
The Wellhead pushes into pipes on any side, no pump needed. Off a vein it brings up water, in the Nether lava
Right-click the gearbox with an empty hand to outline where the parts go
creativeengineering.ponder.lubrication.t: Use an Oil Can of lubricant on any Create machine to oil it
For a Minecraft day it weighs a quarter less on its network: more machines on the same power. Goggles show the time left
Lubricant is heavy oil mixed with kerosene. Fill the can with a Spout, or use it on a tank; a Deployer can use it too
creativeengineering.ponder.tag.creativee: Steel, engines, brewing, distilling and oil, the Create way
